name: io.github.zyvorai/vytrix
title: Vytrix
description: Read-only host activity, history, anomalies and evidence from a Vytrix collector.

environmentVariables.name: VYTRIX_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Vytrix collector, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:9847 or https://vytrix.example. Plain HTTP is accepted only for localhost; inside a container 127.0.0.1 is the container itself, so set this explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: VYTRIX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token of the collector. Read from the environment only; never printed.
